description: Saves one channel setting using WAPI SaveOne. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because channel settings can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

body.description: WAPI ChannelConfiguration SaveOneRequest body: Key, Value.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_save_channel_setting
title: Save Channel Setting
